svg.text: Cut a thin commercial insole to the same outline as the EVA base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a notch 11 mm wide and 1.5 mm deep at the heel edge, on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line, for the tail to turn up the heel counter.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No other holes: the cover is the only layer the foot touches.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: bond it, textile face up, over the spacer with spray contact

svg.text: adhesive suitable for footwear; roll it flat from the heel forward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
